observations: NewRegistry in internal/analyzers/provider.go registers strictly the two shipped non-executing parsers (csv and json) with NonExecuting=true, Executing=false, and ReadOnly=true.

Register and Resolve enforce compile-time allowlist boundaries, rejecting unlisted analyzer IDs (ErrAnalyzerNotAllowlisted), any parser claiming executing behavior (ErrExecutingParserForbidden), and external/remote providers (ErrUnavailableProvider).

Bounded non-executing CSV and JSON/NDJSON parsers enforce MaxInputBytes, MaxRecords, MaxFieldsPerRow, and MaxJSONDepth limits, failing closed with ErrMalformedInput or ErrInputTooLarge on hostile or corrupt inputs.
RunAnalysis validates SealStore prerequisites via evidence.VerifyStoreEvidence before opening committed blobs read-only and asserting SHA-256 identity.

Re-creating the registry after SealStore close and reopen yields identical allowlist descriptors, config digests, tool versions, and parsed records while preserving sealed source bytes unmodified byte-for-byte.
